slides.subtitle: When a graha stands too close to the Sun

slides.label: What it means
slides.title: Combust
body: The old word is asta: set, gone from view

A graha too close to the king
is lost in his light
Its gifts work out of sight

slides.label: In modern life
slides.title: Lost in the glare
cells: You style it, they get the credit
You do the work, someone louder leads
It sounds better from someone else

slides.label: In the sky today
slides.title: The messenger, today
body: Walking backward right beside the king
Texts and ideas get lost in the glare

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
Too close to the light,
no one sees you

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Sign your own work
body: Find which graha sits near your Sun
Do that work under your own name
Post it, sign it, present it yourself
slides.closing: Ask about your Sun at asksutram.com
